valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file, not on H1 2026, the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised; the balance-sheet multiples stand on FY2024
valuation.note: P/E stands on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file; the statement and the ratios above are H1 2026, an interim and not annualised.
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2024, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 46.46 percent a year from FY2023 (2.58768e+09) to FY2025 (5.55065e+09), over 2 years
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2025 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2024
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 7.2473e+07 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_NSE.json)
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 7.2473e+07 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_NSE.json)
